The upper branch, from left to right, is voltage source V1 and impedance -j1 in sequence; the middle branch is voltage source V2 and impedance j1; the lower branch is voltage source V3 and then directly connected to the right-side bus, with no series impedance. The lower branch is labeled with current i, and the arrow direction is from left to right. Reasoning: According to the problem statement/the phasor labels in the figure, interpret the three-phase voltages as balanced phasors: V1 = 100∠0° V, V2 = 100∠−120° V, V3 = 100∠+120° V. Since the lower branch has no series impedance, the voltage of the right-side bus is determined by the V3 branch. Take the current directions of the upper and middle branches as from left to right: I_top = (V1 − V3)/(-j1), I_mid = (V2 − V3)/(j1). Written in rectangular coordinates: V1 = 100, V2 = -50 - j86.6, V3 = -50 + j86.6. Therefore I_top = [100 - (-50 + j86.6)]/(-j) = (150 - j86.6)/(-j) = 86.6 + j150 A. I_mid = [(-50 - j86.6) - (-50 + j86.6)]/j = (-j173.2)/j = -173.2 A. KCL at the right-side node: the lower-branch current i is the opposite of the algebraic sum of the currents in the other two branches, i = -(I_top + I_mid). Therefore i = -[(86.6 + j150) + (-173.2)] = 86.6 - j150 A. Convert to polar coordinates: |i| = sqrt(86.6^2 + 150^2) ≈ 173.2 A, angle = tan⁻¹(-150/86.6) = -60°.

图像描述：电路图中有左右两条公共母线，三条水平支路并联在两母线之间。上支路从左到右依次为电压源 V1 和阻抗 -j1；中支路为电压源 V2 和阻抗 j1；下支路为电压源 V3 后直接连到右侧母线，没有串联阻抗。下支路上标有电流 i，箭头方向为从左向右。

推理：按题意/图中相量标注将三相电压解释为平衡相量：V1 = 100∠0° V，V2 = 100∠−120° V，V3 = 100∠+120° V。由于下支路无串联阻抗，右侧母线电压由 V3 支路确定。取上、中支路电流方向为从左到右：
I_top = (V1 − V3)/(-j1)，I_mid = (V2 − V3)/(j1)。
写成直角坐标：V1 = 100，V2 = -50 - j86.6，V3 = -50 + j86.6。
所以 I_top = [100 - (-50 + j86.6)]/(-j) = (150 - j86.6)/(-j) = 86.6 + j150 A。
I_mid = [(-50 - j86.6) - (-50 + j86.6)]/j = (-j173.2)/j = -173.2 A。
右侧节点 KCL：下支路电流 i 为其余两支路电流代数和的相反数，i = -(I_top + I_mid)。
因此 i = -[(86.6 + j150) + (-173.2)] = 86.6 - j150 A。
转换为极坐标：|i| = sqrt(86.6^2 + 150^2) ≈ 173.2 A，角度 = tan⁻¹(-150/86.6) = -60°。
